decisions.reason: The training programme had its own page for two years, extends the established service offer and costs little to keep, so dropping it would reverse a visible commitment for no real gain.
The fourth-axis accessory complements the core machines and needs little upkeep, so although it was only mentioned rather than featured, the firm has little reason to remove it.

Hybrid additive post-processing is far from the core offer and was only mentioned, so less is at stake, but it fits the announced direction toward future-oriented production and materials processing, which favours persisting.

The high-speed CNC milling line is a multi-model, heavily invested product at the centre of the firm's identity and was presented on its own page, so escalation of commitment strongly favours keeping it.
The automatic tool change system is integral to the machine offering, was featured on its own page, and represents engineering investment that management would not write off.
